headline: Archipelago remembers save-slot rooms; Difficulty fixes Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0, Item Randomizer v1.0.4 and Difficulty v1.2.4 were released against Mod SDK 1.11.0. Archipelago now remembers each memory-card slot's room and refuses another seed's save, alongside logic, reconnect and client fixes (#24, #26). Difficulty keeps Blarg Station's ship and Clank from disappearing when enemy count is set to 2 by reserving room for the level's own spawns (#34).
highlights: Players are asked to help test item-access logic in #25, including Trespasser checks on return Veldin, Aridia and Batalia, and Eudora's Suck Cannon warp pad.
Listings now state AI assistance per mod, and release publishing starts the index rebuild directly (#27, #33).
Listing checks now reject a broken newest release rather than silently offering an older one (#32).
Expanded co-op with cross-region parties, dedicated saves and host takeover remains an unmerged draft, not ready for review or merge (#22).
